scientific.integrity: The all-orders result is proved by a necessary-and-sufficient label-2 case partition. Exhaustive enumeration for orders 6, 8, 10, and 12 independently checks every polynomial coefficient; those finite checks are corroborative rather than a substitute for proof.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is for connected crown graphs with n at least 3; the disconnected n=2 case and other deleted-edge families are outside scope. Literature searches cannot exclude differently indexed equivalent work.

title: Roman domination polynomial of crown graphs
